LOR_FIRST_ENEMY_FTUE_BODY:
Library enemies calculate [gold]Slash[/gold], [gold]Pierce[/gold], and [gold]Blunt[/gold] resistance separately.

The icons beside an enemy's HP bar show the effectiveness of each attribute.
During testing, all base-game attacks have the [gold]Blunt[/gold] attribute.
LOR_FIRST_ENEMY_FTUE_BODY_1:
The upper row of icons beside the enemy HP bar shows resistance to [red]Attack[/red] damage dealt by [gold]Slash[/gold], [gold]Pierce[/gold], and [gold]Blunt[/gold].

Try to attack with an attribute matching a weakness. A resisted attribute [red]greatly[/red] reduces damage.
LOR_FIRST_ENEMY_FTUE_BODY_2:
Some Library enemies also display a second row of icons used to calculate [gold]Stagger[/gold] damage.

Stagger Resistance is unaffected by base-game effects such as [gold]Vulnerable, Weak, and Strength[/gold], but is affected by Library buffs such as [gold]Power Up[/gold]. Its base value is the card's base Attack damage.
LOR_FIRST_ABNORMALITY_FTUE_BODY: Abnormalities also have attribute resistances. The icons marked by the arrows show their current response to [gold]Slash[/gold], [gold]Pierce[/gold], and [gold]Blunt[/gold].
LOR_FIRST_ABNORMALITY_FTUE_BODY_1: Abnormalities also calculate resistances separately for [red]Attack[/red] damage dealt by [gold]Slash[/gold], [gold]Pierce[/gold], and [gold]Blunt[/gold].
LOR_FIRST_ABNORMALITY_FTUE_BODY_2:
When Stagger Resistance icons are present, they are calculated separately from Physical Resistance.

Stagger Resistance is unaffected by base-game effects such as [gold]Vulnerable, Weak, and Strength[/gold], but is affected by Library buffs such as [gold]Power Up[/gold]. Its base value is the card's base Attack damage.
LOR_FIRST_ABNORMALITY_FTUE_BODY_3:
After defeating an Abnormality, an [gold]Abnormality Page[/gold] relic may appear on the rewards screen.

These Pages are rewards that remain active for the current run. When obtained, Page relics let you choose one of several effects.
LOR_FIRST_LIBERATION_FTUE_BODY: A Floor Realization has [blue]5[/blue] or [blue]6[/blue] phases. At the end of each phase, some HP is restored and dead teammates are revived. Complete at least two phases to win.
LOR_FIRST_LIBERATION_FTUE_BODY_1:
Enemies in Floor Realizations may have a separate [gold]Stagger Resistance[/gold] bar above their HP bar.

Reduce this bar to [blue]0[/blue] to [gold]Stagger[/gold] the enemy. While Staggered, the enemy takes increased damage and is [gold]Stunned[/gold] for one turn.
LOR_FIRST_LIBERATION_FTUE_BODY_2:
The Stagger Resistance icons determine how much [gold]Stagger[/gold] damage each attribute deals.

They show how [gold]Slash[/gold], [gold]Pierce[/gold], and [gold]Blunt[/gold] affect the Stagger value.
LOR_FIRST_LIBERATION_FTUE_BODY_3: A Floor Realization has [blue]5[/blue] or [blue]6[/blue] phases. At the end of each phase, some HP is restored and dead teammates are revived. Complete at least two phases to win.
LOR_COMBAT_FTUE_20260827_RESISTANCE_BODY: The red icons beside an enemy's HP bar show [red]Physical Resistance[/red], while the gold icons show [gold]Stagger Resistance[/gold]. Each group is ordered [gold]Slash[/gold], [gold]Pierce[/gold], and [gold]Blunt[/gold] from top to bottom. Hover an icon to open its Damage Type Resistance description and current multiplier, such as “Pierce Physical Resistance: Normal (×1)” or “Slash Stagger Resistance: Immune (×0)”.
LOR_COMBAT_FTUE_20260827_MAPPING_TITLE: Library of Ruina: Attack Type Mapping
LOR_COMBAT_FTUE_20260827_MAPPING_BODY:
Mods without a [gold]LibraryLib[/gold] dependency cannot assign custom damage types to Attack cards, so the following mapping is used consistently:

[gold]Single-target attacks[/gold] — [gold]Blunt[/gold]
[gold]Multi-hit attacks[/gold] — [gold]Pierce[/gold]
[gold]AoE attacks[/gold] — [gold]Slash[/gold]

Most cards with both multi-hit and AoE effects are classified as [gold]Pierce[/gold].

Settings provide three resistance choices: [gold]Normal Resistances[/gold] — [gold]Weak Resistances[/gold] — [gold]Ignore Resistances[/gold].
LOR_COMBAT_FTUE_20260827_RESISTANCE_MODE: Normal Resistances · Weak Resistances · Ignore Resistances
LOR_ABNORMALITY_PAGE_REWARD_FTUE_BODY:
This reward is an [gold]Abnormality Page[/gold]. Once obtained, it becomes a Page relic that remains active for the current run.

Click it to open the selection screen and choose one of several Abnormality Pages.
LOR_NEOW_SPECIAL_GUEST_FTUE_RELIC_BODY:
[red]This relic is currently unfinished and should remain disabled.[/red] Once enabled, you can encounter [gold]Special Guests[/gold] in [blue]? rooms[/blue] (see the next page).

Each Special Guest has an individual unlock condition. In general, the more battles you fight and the stronger your build becomes during Acts 1 and 2, the easier those conditions are to meet.
LOR_NEOW_SPECIAL_GUEST_FTUE_OVERVIEW_BOD:
Every Special Guest ultimately offers [blue]2–3[/blue] options. The first option currently grants no special reward; it is connected to entering Act 4, and you may choose it when you want the challenge.

These guests have high combat values. Choose whether to challenge them or flee with care.
LOR_NEOW_SPECIAL_GUEST_FTUE_EMOTION_BODY:
Special Guests have a unique mechanic: [purple]Emotion Level[/purple].

Taking or dealing damage grants Emotion Points, but points gained within a turn cannot exceed the current level's cap. Filling the gauge raises Emotion Level by 1.

[b]I: Gain 3 permanent Power Up.[/b]
[b]II: Gain 20 Regen and 1 permanent Power Up.[/b]
[b]III: Gain 50 Plating and 1 permanent Power Up.[/b]
[b]IV: Intent capacity +1; gain 1 permanent Power Up.[/b]
[b]V: Every 3 turns, gain 1 Intangible and 1 permanent Power Up.[/b]
LOR_UPDATE_LOG_20260902_NOTICE_BODY:
This version is in the public balance-tuning phase. The current plan is to adjust the difficulty curve of [blue]Acts 2–3[/blue] while strengthening both players and monsters.

If the monsters in the current version feel too strong, please leave feedback in the comments!

The difficulty jump between [gold]A7[/gold] and [gold]A8–10[/gold] is substantial. If the game feels too difficult, lower the difficulty below [gold]A8[/gold], or pair this mod with my [gold]Roland Mod[/gold] for the challenge.
LOR_UPDATE_LOG_20260902_SCOPE_BODY:
This changelog uses [gold]v0.15.0[/gold], the final version before the Literature Floor was added, as its baseline and compares it with [gold]v0.18.3[/gold].

Highlights include the Literature Floor Liberation, Judgement Bird Elite, and Blue Star Strong encounters; seven new three-choice Abnormality Pages; extensive enemy, Page, E.G.O., and Liberation balance changes; plus improved animation, backgrounds, audio, rewards, and multiplayer synchronization.
LOR_UPDATE_LOG_20260902_LITERATURE_BODY:
Added [gold]Hod / the Literature Floor[/gold] and its complete [blue]five-phase[/blue] Liberation battle:

[blue]Laetitia[/blue] → [red]Red Eyes[/red] → [red]Bloodlust[/red] → [gold]Today's Expression[/gold] → [blue]Dream of a Black Swan[/blue]

Each phase has unique enemies, mechanics, animations, backgrounds, audio, and transitions. Post-battle rewards now scale with cleared phases and include the [gold]Dream of a Black Swan Page[/gold].
LOR_UPDATE_LOG_20260902_ENCOUNTERS_TITLE: New: Judgement Bird and Blue Star
LOR_UPDATE_LOG_20260902_ENCOUNTERS_BODY:
Added the [gold]Judgement Bird[/gold] Elite encounter, built around Sin, the scale, and Judgement, with a dedicated background, animations, and judgement sequence.

Added the [blue]Blue Star[/blue] Strong encounter, where an altar and multiple followers fight together through Voice, Martyrdom, and Return mechanics.

Both encounters grant their own three-choice Abnormality Page rewards.
LOR_UPDATE_LOG_20260902_PAGES_BODY:
Added the [gold]Snow White's Apple[/gold], [gold]Der Freischütz[/gold], [gold]The Silent Orchestra[/gold], [gold]Nothing There[/gold], [gold]Dream of a Black Swan[/gold], [gold]Judgement Bird[/gold], and [gold]Blue Star[/gold] Pages.

Each Page now offers a [blue]choice of three[/blue] effects after acquisition, with complete choice cards, icons, and localization. Tiered Liberation rewards also grant the corresponding Page.
LOR_UPDATE_LOG_20260902_BALANCE_BODY:
Retuned HP, damage, Powers, and move sequencing across [blue]Acts 2–3[/blue] normal, Strong, Elite, and Floor Liberation battles, with steeper enemy scaling at high Ascension.

Abnormality Pages, E.G.O. cards, Liberation rewards, and several player mechanics were strengthened to support higher build ceilings.

This range also fixes numerous phase-transition, reward-resume, save, and multiplayer-sync issues while improving dedicated backgrounds, animations, audio, and combat information.
